answer_1.quote: We employed two public datasets: C4 subset for newslike (high-entropy) text generation and HumanEval for code (low-entropy) generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text sequences and code snippets

answer_2.quote: For text quality, we measured perplexity (PPL) and coherence for generations on C4; We computed PPL and pass@k scores of code generations for HumanEval.
